'''Ulfor Bombaasa''' was a light-skinned, [[Color/Legends|brown]]-[[Hair/Legends|haired]] [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="DaG" /> who patronized the [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|84|Bombaasa, Ulfor}}</ref> in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]].<ref name="SWCTP">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="ROTS date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> Bombaasa attended a showing<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> of the ballet ''[[Squid Lake/Legends|Squid Lake]]''<ref name="ROTS IS">[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay'']]</ref> at the [[Opera/Legends|opera]] house,<ref name="ROTS" /> wearing a mauve and black [[Jacket/Legends|coat]], mauve [[Clothing/Legends|pants]], pink [[shirt]], black [[Boot/Legends|boots]], gold [[Sash/Legends|sash]], and a gold pendant.<ref name="DaG" /> At that performance, Bombaasa ascended the opera house's stairs holding hands and conversing with<ref name="ROTS" /> the opera [[Musician/Legends|singer]]<ref name="Starship">{{StarshipsVehiclesCite|11|Star Wars A&ndash;Z}}</ref> [[Opula Deget/Legends|Opula Deget]].<ref name="DaG" /> The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] ran past the pair on his way to meet with [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in Palpatine's [[Palpatine's private viewing box|private box]].<ref name="ROTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ulfor Bombaasa first appeared, portrayed by an uncredited extra, in the final [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="ROTS" /> which premiered on [[May 19]], [[2005]].<ref name="Year by year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> The opera house scenes featuring the character were filmed at [[Shepperton Studios]] as part of additional photography on [[August 23]], [[2004]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> Bombaasa was identified by name in the reference book ''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]'', written by [[Trisha Biggar]]<ref name="DaG" /> and released on [[October 11]], 2005.<ref name="DressingDate">{{WebCite|url=https://www.waterstones.com/book/dressing-a-galaxy-part-1/trisha-biggar/george-lucas/9780810959644|text=Dressing a Galaxy: Part 1: The Costumes of Star Wars (Hardback)|work=[[Wikipedia:Waterstones|Waterstones]]|archivedate=20260701041521}}</ref>
